title: Tesla Plans to End Cybertruck Production Next Year
excerpt: Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production around the middle of next year at its Texas Gigafactory to increase Cybercab output.
body_html:
Tesla is reportedly preparing to end the production of its Cybertruck in order to focus more resources on its robotaxi vehicles. According to a social media post by CEO Elon Musk on Friday, the company intends to wind down Cybertruck manufacturing at the Texas Gigafactory around the middle of next year.

The decision is designed to free up space and capacity for increased production of the Cybercab. Musk shared these plans as part of the company's upcoming strategic shift toward expanding its robotaxi output.
